summary: Enhance your financial skills with our comprehensive training in financial modeling and forecasting. Unlock insights and drive better business decisions today.
lede: Financial forecasting and modelling helps finance professionals turn historical results and operating assumptions into linked projections for planning, budgeting, and investment decisions. The course covers building a three-statement model in Excel, mapping revenue and working-capital drivers, and testing assumptions with scenario and sensitivity analysis for forecast reporting and valuation inputs.
audienceIntro: This course is built for finance professionals who need to create, review, or present financial models that support planning, valuation, budgeting, and performance decisions.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of accounting terminology, including the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement. You should be comfortable using Microsoft Excel at a beginner to intermediate level, including formulas, cell references, and worksheet navigation. No coding is required. If you regularly prepare budgets, forecasts, management reports, or investment analyses, you are well placed to benefit from this course. Laptops with Microsoft Excel installed are required for the hands-on exercises.
